translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: MARCOS
book.title: Dos Moppiyon Dinoggan no id Sulat ni MARCOS

content: Dos Kodpoka-an ni Disas to Oppat no Maan (4,000) no Minuvu
Sokkad no timpu, nolivuung mandon iddos mo-uraan minuvu. Na-amin don kos tasak dan, de-en id poporani ni Disas iddos mgo tinodduwan din woy id ikohiyan din to,
“No-eruwan a ka-ay't mo-uraan minuvu, oyyos notolluwan don nid duma ran koddi no worad tasak dan.
Na, otid po-uliyon ku sikandan no diid pokoka-an, od moomet dan to gutas diyot daan, su duwon duma no moriyu pa kos od uliyan.”
Kahi taddot mgo tinodduwan din to, “Oyya en, piru ingkon ki man od poko-angoy to id poka-an ta ka-ay't mo-uraan minuvu, su ini ki man to noka-awoy-awoy'n lugaa?”
Mid intud si Disas kandan, kahi rin to, “Pilon molison kos paan duwot koniyu?” Id tavak sikandan to, “Pittu.”

Na, id po-unsad ni Disas iddos mo-uraan minuvu, woy id angoy rin iddos pittun paan woy id posolamat sikandin diyot Monama. Nopongnga, id pontoppiktoppik din idda woy id boggoy riyot mgo tinodduwan din amoy id sondad diyot mgo minuvu.
Duwon mandad pilopilon ngaap. Id posolamat mandon si Disas tadda riyon to Monama, woy id posondad din mandad idda taddot mgo tinodduwan din diyot mgo minuvu.
Na, nokoka-an dan langun woy nongovuung. To nopongnga ran mid ka-an, nokolimud iddos mgo tinodduwan to nongosama no nokoponnu to pittun doorakkoon bukag.
Dos ko-uralloy to minuvu nid ka-an, mgo oppat no maan (4,000).
Nopongnga idda, id popo-uli ni Disas iddos mgo minuvu.
Woy id sakoy sikandin to bollangay duma to mgo tinodduwan din po-undiyot lugaa to Dalmanuta.
Dos Kodbuyu to mgo Pariseo no od Pokitannon Sikandan to Mokososoobbu

Na, to kod-inguma ran diyot Dalmanuta, duwon mgo Pariseo no id porani ki Disas amoy'd opilon sikandin diyot opulanan, su id kopi-i ran nod posaharon sikandin. De-en id buyu ran kandin no od pokitannon sikandan to mokososoobbu nod posivonnaa no id popiyod en sikandin to Monama.

Id songnga si Disas to moraom, su id mosakit kos ginawa rin woy mid ikahi sikandin to, “Ooy koniyu no mgo minuvu to inin timpu! Mambot od buyu kow pa nod pokitannon to mokososoobbu? Bonnaavonnaa nod ikohiyon ku koniyu, no waa en mokososoobbu no id pokita ku koniyu.”
Na, id tanan onsi Disas kandan woy mid sakoy mandon to bollangay woy id tollus dan diyot dipaa to lanow.
Id Ponunggelengan ni Disas to Potuvu to Paan iddos Nonaw to mgo Pariseo woy ki Herodes
Na, nolingow iddos mgo tinodduwan ni Disas no id piyod to tasak dan no paan, woy sokkad dobbon molison no paan kos diyot bollangay ran.
Id osengan sikandan ni Disas ukit to ponunggelengan, kahi rin to, “Bantoy kow taddot potuvu to paan to mgo Pariseo woy ki Harin Herodes.”
To id oseng ni Disas idda, id po-ikohiyoy ran to, “Saddook id oseng din idda su wora ki man nokopiyod to paan.”
Na nokosaddoo si Disas taddot mgo osengan dan, de-en mid ikahi sikandin to, “Mambot nosasow kow no waa kow nokopiyod to paan? Waa kow pobbos nokaabbot? Mambot motoggas kow nod pokaabbot?
Duwon mata row, piru konna kow od pokokita, woy duwon tolinga row, piru konna kow od pokorinog. Nolingow kowd bo taddot id puungan ku?
Iddot id pontoppiktoppik ku iddos limmon molison no paan nid poka-an ku taddot limmon maan (5,000) no minuvu, pilon bukag kos noponnu row tat nongosama?” Mid tavak sikandan to, “Sopuu-oruwa.”

Na mid ikahi mandon si Disas to, “Iddot id pontoppiktoppik ku iddos pittun molison no paan nid poka-an ku taddot oppat no maan (4,000) no minuvu, pilon doorakkoon bukag kos noponnu row tat nongosama?” Mid tavak sikandan to, “Pittu.”
Kahi rin kandan to, “Waa kow pobbos nokaabbot no inis id nonaw ku, konna moka-atag to paan?”
Id Bowiyan ni Disas iddos Butud diyon to Betsaida
To id inguma onsi Disas diyot bonuwa to Betsaida, duwon mgo minuvu no id undiyot ki Disas woy id piyod sikandan to butud no mama. Id po-eru-eru ran nod somaddan din iddos butud amoy'd ko-uliyan.

Na id pikit ni Disas iddos butud, woy id leggua ran taddon bariyu. To nokoleggua ron sikandan, id ilobban din iddos mata taddot butud, id somaddan din sikandin woy id inturan, kahi rin to, “Ondan, duwon don od kokita ru?”
Na id langngag boyow iddos butud woy mid tavak to, “Oyya, od pokokita a to mgo minuvu, piru iling da to mgo kayu nod ipopanow.”
Id somaddan mandon ni Disas iddos mata taddot butud. Na, id totongtong iddos minuvu woy moppiya ron kos kod-ontong din.
Nopongnga idda, id po-uli sikandin ni Disas woy id ikohiyan din to, “Yo ka vo od baya riyot bonuwa nid pomonnan ta.”
Dos Tavak ni Pedro no si Disas kos Mesiyas

Na, mid undiyon si Disas woy dos mgo tinodduwan din to mgo bariyu no sakup to bonuwa to Cesarea Filipos, woy laggun tid ipanow ran, id intud si Disas kandan, kahi rin to, “Ondoy a man diyot poomdom to mgo minuvu?”
Mid tavak sikandan to, “Duwon id ikahi no sikkow kun si Juan no Tohodboutismu. Dos duma mid ikahi no sikkow si Elias, woy duwon duma nid ikahi no sokkad ka taddot mgo propeta dangan.”
Kahin Disas to, “Piru atag koniyu, ondoy a man?” Mid tavak si Pedro to, “Sikkow en kos Mesiyas.”
Na, id loglohottan din iddos mgo tinodduwan no dii ran id ponudtuu riyot ahad ondoy iddos moka-atag kandin.
Dos Unnon Kodponudtuu ni Disas Moka-atag to Kopotayan Din

Na, mid tigkanoy ron si Disas to kodpaabbotlabbot diyot mgo tinodduwan din moka-atag tod kotomanan din. Kahi rin to, “Siyak no Anak to Minuvu, ko-ilangan nod ukit to mo-uraan kodposuppit, woy od elleyan a tod pombuyyahon to mgo Judio, taddot mgo ponguu to tohodbuwis woy taddot mgo tohodnonaw to Suhu ni Moises. Od imotayan a, piru riyot iko-otollun allow, od kovadnow a.”

Iddos langun no id ponudtuu ni Disas diyot mgo tinodduwan din moka-atag to kopotayan din, moomok da nod koovottan. To norinog idda ni Pedro, id piyod din si Disas diyot ibpit woy id sugga rin, kahi rin to, “Yo kod oseng to ungketen.”
Piru mid isau si Disas diyot mgo tinodduwan din woy id sugga rin si Pedro, kahi rin to, “Awa ka, Moivuyan! Su iddos poomdom du, konna pomon to Monama, ko konna, pomon to minuvu.”

Na, id poporani ni Disas iddos mgo minuvu woy dos mgo tinodduwan din woy id ikohiyan din to, “Iddos ahad ondoy no od kopiyan nod kovovallan no tinodduwan ku, ko-ilangan nod inoyyuhan din kos kandin nid kopi-i, woy od tiyangon din iddos kandin no krus
amoy'd dumoruma koddi.

Oyya su iddos minuvu nod konuhunan to umuu rin, od koworan da en baling tadda. Piru iddos ahad ondoy nod patoy pomon to koddumoruma rin koddi woy pomon to kodponudtuu rin to Moppiyon Dinoggan, duwon umuun waad tomanon.
Su ahad od kokomunoy to minuvu kos langun no korotuwan ka-ay to ampow't ingod, waa en koru-anon otid koworan sikandin to umuun waad tomanon.
Oyyos waa korotuwan no id pokovullas to minuvu amoy'd ka-awi rin iddos umuun waad tomanon.

Dos mgo minuvu to inin timpu, oray'n mosaasaa su id inoyyuhan dan kos Monama. Na otik id ko-ilow a nikandan woy dos mgo nonaw ku, siyak no Anak to Minuvu, id ko-ilow ku mandad sikandan init kodlivod ku nod dumannan to se-aa to kotuusan to Amoy ku woy taddot uhis no mgo ponolihan.”

footnotes.text: Waa pa apii to kod-iyap iddos mgo ba-ay woy mgo anak.
Otik diyot Griego no kinohiyan, Cristo, woy riyot Hebreo, Mesiyas. Od kovasa kos kohulugan to Mesiyas diyot listahan to Mgo Kahi no Dakkoo kos Koru-anon diyon to kotompusan no mgo lokkeb.
Dos kohulugan to kahi no, od tiyang to krus,idda en so kodtuman to suhu ni Disas ahad ondan pa kos od kotomanan.
